parsed_output.analysis: The model captures a HumanDriving simple state and an Autonomous sub-machine with Idle/Active substates, but the power-on/off wiring and the scope of the human-intervention transitions do not match the specification. The initial entry to HumanDriving is unlabeled, a Power On transition is placed in the wrong direction, Power Off is only modelled from HumanDriving to a state named AutonomousFinal, and the Human Steering Cmd / Brake Pressed returns to HumanDriving are limited to AutonomousActive instead of the autonomous mode as specified.

issues.issue: Power-on entry to HumanDriving is unlabeled and Power On transition is reversed
issues.reason: Specification 3 requires 'when power on, the system turn into human driving mode'. The model shows an unlabeled initial transition [*] --> HumanDriving and a transition HumanDriving --> Autonomous labeled 'Power On', which is the opposite direction and does not label the start-up as Power On.
issues.where: [*] --> HumanDriving and HumanDriving --> Autonomous : Power On

issues.issue: Power Off transition source and final state do not match specification
issues.reason: Specification 5 requires 'when power off, it will transit to final state'. The model only allows Power Off from HumanDriving to AutonomousFinal, and names the final state AutonomousFinal, with no Power Off exit from Autonomous and no generic Final state as implied.
issues.where: HumanDriving --> AutonomousFinal : Power Off and state AutonomousFinal : Auto Final State

issues.issue: Human Steering Cmd / Brake Pressed return to HumanDriving is restricted to AutonomousActive
issues.reason: Specification 4 states 'transit to human driving mode when receive human steering cmd, brake pressed, in (auto final)'. The model only allows those events to return to HumanDriving from AutonomousActive, not from the autonomous mode as a whole / the autonomous final context, and it does not allow the return from AutonomousIdle.
issues.where: AutonomousActive --> HumanDriving : Human Steering Cmd and AutonomousActive --> HumanDriving : Brake Pressed

issues.issue: Autonomous sub-machine entry behavior is modelled as a guarded transition
issues.reason: Specification 2 requires autonomous mode to have sub-states and be a sub-machine. The model models entry into the sub-machine with a guarded transition Autonomous --> AutonomousIdle on Front Distance <= 10 rather than defining an initial substate. This adds an extra, unspecified guard for entering the idle substate.

system_prompt:
You are an experienced control-systems engineer reviewing a state machine model against the natural-language specification it was built from.

You are given two things, both complete and unmodified:
  1. The natural-language specification.
  2. A state machine model written in PlantUML.

Your task: identify the places where the model does not conform to the specification. Read the specification in full first, then read the model in full, then report what you find.

Report as many or as few issues as you actually find, and organize them however you judge best. For each issue, state what the non-conformance is, which part of the model it concerns, and why you consider it a non-conformance.

Write your findings in en-US. Return only the requested structured response.
user_prompt:
## Natural-language specification

1 The human driving mode is represented by a simple state. 2 The autonomous mode has sub-states and is represented by a sub machine state. 3. when power on, the system turn into human driving mode 4when front_distance > 10, auto transport to autonomous state 4. transit to human driving mode when receive human steering cmd, brake pressed, in (auto final) 5 when power off, it will transit to final state

## State machine model (PlantUML)

@startuml
[*] --> HumanDriving
HumanDriving : Human Driving Mode

HumanDriving --> Autonomous : Power On
Autonomous : Autonomous Mode
Autonomous : <<submachine>>

Autonomous --> AutonomousIdle : Front Distance <= 10
AutonomousIdle : Autonomous Idle Mode

AutonomousIdle --> AutonomousActive : Front Distance > 10
AutonomousActive : Autonomous Active Mode

AutonomousActive --> HumanDriving : Human Steering Cmd
AutonomousActive --> HumanDriving : Brake Pressed

HumanDriving --> Autonomous : Front Distance > 10
HumanDriving --> AutonomousFinal : Power Off

AutonomousFinal : Auto Final State
@enduml
